explication: DuckDuckGo Android is a consumer browser app with privacy-protection features and supporting services. A typical user journey is to browse a site, where browser state and web storage are managed alongside protections; users can also configure app-tracking protection, use Duck.ai, run personal-information-removal scans, and manage subscription-related prompts. The graph emphasizes these product areas and their visible runtime links. Several subsystems are represented by directory-level nodes because their implementation files were not sampled; those links are omitted rather than inferred.
